sentences.text: The applicable directions for loans sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026 say that for all floating-rate loans to individuals for purposes other than business, a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges.
Because this case is a floating-rate loan to an individual for a non-business purpose sanctioned in 2026, a 4% foreclosure charge is not permitted under the applicable directions.
The bank’s own home-loan documents state 2% in one version and 3% in another version, but those provisions are overridden here by the applicable UCB directions.

missing.searched: Looked for an applicable rule permitting a 4% foreclosure charge on a floating-rate home loan to an individual sanctioned in 2026; the in-force UCB directions instead prohibit pre-payment charges for this case.
